description: This Dart source file defines a TagProvider class that manages a list of Tag objects, interacts with a TagRepository for CRUD operations, and notifies listeners of changes. It appears to be part of a Flutter app's state management, providing reactive updates to widgets.

classes.name: TagProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages Tag instances, providing methods for listening, adding, updating, and deleting tags, while notifying listeners on changes.

methods.name: TagProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a repository and a user ID generator, and sets up listening.

methods.name: _listen
methods.description: Sets up a stream subscription to watch all tags for the current user ID and updates internal list on data change.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Creates a new tag for the current user.

methods.name: updateTag
methods.description: Updates an existing tag for the current user.

methods.name: deleteTag
methods.description: Deletes a tag by ID for the current user.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the stream subscription and cleans up resources.
